app: THE PLATINUM RUN — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Tracker
tagline: All 55 official GTA VI trophies with our own cited guides, live Exophase rarity, working counters, a 7-stage roadmap and the one missable flagged.
rarityNote: Rarity is the share of tracked players who have earned the trophy, read live from the Exophase GTA VI trophy page on 20 Nov 2026; the launch figure is the frozen launch-night read of 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.summary: The Platinum awards itself the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do beyond finishing the whole list.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies first; this one unlocks automatically once every one of them is done.
Plan the run as a single playthrough: there are no difficulty settings, no mission replay and no New Game+, but free roam continues after the story.
Budget roughly 200 hours in total — about 60 to 80 for the story, around 100 on the 100% checklist, then a final cleanup stretch.
Never use cheats on your trophy save: using one disables trophies and saving for the session.
Keep manual saves at the start and end of every chapter — you have 15 slots plus an autosave — so a mistake never costs a restart.
All 55 trophies are single-player: there are no online or DLC trophies on the list.

trophies.guide: The Platinum awards itself the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Steps: 1) Earn the other 54 trophies first; this one unlocks automatically once every one of them is done. 2) Plan a single playthrough — no difficulty settings, no mission replay, no New Game+, but free roam continues after the story. 3) Budget roughly 200 hours: 60 to 80 for the story, around 100 on the 100% checklist, then cleanup. 4) Never use cheats on your trophy save; a cheat disables trophies and saving for the session. 5) Keep manual saves at the start and end of every chapter — 15 slots plus an autosave. 6) All 55 trophies are single-player, with no online or DLC trophies.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.summary: Story trophy for Gone Fishing, one of the first missions of Chapter 1 — it awards itself as you play the opening.

steps.text: Play the opening of Chapter 1 and finish the mission Gone Fishing; the trophy pops as part of the story.
It cannot be missed: story trophies unlock automatically as you play through the five chapters.
No preparation is needed — just play the mission, and keep cheats off so trophies stay enabled.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for Gone Fishing, one of the first missions of Chapter 1. Steps: 1) Finish Gone Fishing in the Chapter 1 opening and the trophy pops as part of the story. 2) It cannot be missed — story trophies unlock automatically across the five chapters. 3) No preparation needed; keep cheats off so trophies stay enabled.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.summary: Finish Chapter 1. Before you leave the chapter behind, grab the one missable moment in the game at Jason's house.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 1; the trophy is awarded as Chapter 2 begins, once you have played the first mission of the new chapter.
Before Chapter 1 ends, do the balcony meditation at Jason's house with Lucia — it feeds Positive Mental Attitude, the one possibly-missable trophy.
Story trophies cannot be missed, and everything else from Chapter 1 stays reachable in free roam.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Steps: 1) Complete Chapter 1; the trophy is awarded as Chapter 2 begins, after its first mission. 2) Before the chapter ends, do the balcony meditation at Jason's house with Lucia — it feeds the possibly-missable Positive Mental Attitude. 3) Story trophies cannot be missed and everything else stays reachable in free roam.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.summary: Finish Chapter 2 — the chapter where partner free-roam opens up, which several later trophies depend on.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 2; the trophy arrives as Chapter 3 begins, after Welcome to Vice City.
Partner switching opens right after Breakfast Run in this chapter, which the partner trophies later rely on.
It cannot be missed — chapter trophies award automatically in story order.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Steps: 1) Complete Chapter 2; the trophy arrives as Chapter 3 begins, after Welcome to Vice City. 2) Partner switching opens right after Breakfast Run here, which later partner trophies rely on. 3) Chapter trophies award automatically in story order and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.summary: Finish Chapter 3, the chapter that hands you the Snap Gun and opens the jewelry-job content.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 3; the trophy lands after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
Chapter 3 brings Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which give you the Snap Gun that Sneakthief relies on.
Chapter trophies cannot be missed; they pop in order as the story advances.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Steps: 1) Complete Chapter 3; the trophy lands after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. 2) Chapter 3 brings Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs and the Snap Gun that Sneakthief relies on. 3) Chapter trophies pop in story order and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.summary: Finish Chapter 4. Late in this chapter the bank-vault content unlocks, so it is the last big setup chapter before the finale.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 4 to earn it — it cannot be missed.
Late in Chapter 4, the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… opens up bank vaults, the backbone of Maximum Withdrawal.
Keep a manual save before the finale: the next chapter ends the story, and there is no mission replay.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Steps: 1) Complete Chapter 4 — it cannot be missed. 2) Late in the chapter, the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… opens bank vaults, the backbone of Maximum Withdrawal. 3) Keep a manual save before the finale; there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.summary: The gold story trophy: finish the final mission of Chapter 5. Everything else can still be cleaned up in free roam afterwards.

steps.text: Complete the final mission of Chapter 5; this gold trophy awards automatically at the end of the story.
Free roam carries on after the credits, so every other trophy can still be cleaned up afterwards.
Before the finale, bank a manual save — with no mission replay, a clean pre-finale save is your only way back.

trophies.guide: The gold story trophy: finish the final mission. Steps: 1) Complete the final mission of Chapter 5; the trophy awards automatically at the end of the story. 2) Free roam carries on after the credits, so everything else can be cleaned up afterwards. 3) Bank a manual save before the finale — there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.summary: Finish Breakfast Run in Chapter 2 — a small mission with a big side effect: it opens partner switching.

steps.text: Complete Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 story mission; the trophy pops automatically.
Breakfast Run matters beyond itself: partner switching opens right after it, unlocking partner free-roam.
Like every story trophy, it cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Finish Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Steps: 1) Complete the mission and the trophy pops automatically. 2) Partner switching opens right after it, unlocking partner free-roam. 3) Like every story trophy, it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.summary: Finish The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 story mission — it awards itself as the story plays out.

steps.text: Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3; the trophy pops automatically at the end of the mission.
There are no mission gold medals to worry about — finishing the mission is enough.
It cannot be missed, like every story trophy.

trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 story mission. Steps: 1) Complete the heist and the trophy pops automatically. 2) There are no mission gold medals — finishing is enough. 3) It cannot be missed, like every story trophy.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.summary: Finish Child's Play in Chapter 4 — a straight story award on the road to the finale.

steps.text: Complete Child's Play, a Chapter 4 story mission; it awards automatically.
Chapter 4 missions need no special performance — there are no mission gold medals in the game.
It cannot be missed, like every story trophy.

trophies.guide: Finish Child's Play in Chapter 4. Steps: 1) Complete the mission and it awards automatically. 2) No special performance is needed — there are no mission gold medals. 3) It cannot be missed, like every story trophy.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.summary: Finish Headliners in Chapter 4 as the story closes in on its endgame.

steps.text: Complete Headliners in Chapter 4; the trophy pops at the end of the mission.
Story trophies pop in order and cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Finish Headliners in Chapter 4. Steps: 1) Complete the mission and the trophy pops at its end. 2) Story trophies pop in order and cannot be missed. 3) Keep rotating manual saves through Chapter 4 — the finale is close and there is no replay.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.summary: Finish VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4 — and take note of the airport while you are there; another trophy needs it later.

steps.text: Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4; the trophy awards automatically.

It cannot be missed, like every story trophy.

trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Steps: 1) Complete the mission; the trophy awards automatically. 2) The same airport hosts Catch Me If You Can — the planes that count are large passenger jets docked at boarding bridges. 3) It cannot be missed, like every story trophy.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.summary: Finish Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5, one of the last story beats before the final mission.

steps.text: Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5, the final chapter.
It lands shortly before the final mission — keep a pre-finale manual save in one of your 15 slots.
Story trophies cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. Steps: 1) Complete the mission in the final chapter. 2) It lands shortly before the final mission — keep a pre-finale manual save. 3) Story trophies cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.summary: The hardest trophy on the list: fill the 100% Completion checklist. It only appears after the story, but everything you do during the story already counts — and it asks for roughly 60% of the game's true content, not all of it.

steps.text: Finish the story first: the checklist appears at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion afterwards, and progress made during the story already counts.
Required in full: all Robberies, Underwater Discoveries, Shooting Ranges, Drone Races and Bret's quests — plan to complete those categories completely.
Only shares of the rest are needed: scan any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles and study any 100 of 255 animals with binoculars.
Complete any 100 optional missions — 200 to 300 or more exist, marked with purple icons and black icons with pink letters.
Reach 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 15 of 18 meditations for the checklist — the standalone trophies for those ask for less or the same.
Expect this to be the longest stretch of the run: guides put the checklist phase at around 100 hours.
Nothing on the checklist is missable, so all of it can be finished in post-story free roam.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy: fill the 100% Completion checklist, which appears after the story while earlier progress already counts. Steps: 1) Finish the story, then work the checklist at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. 2) Required in full: all Robberies, Underwater Discoveries, Shooting Ranges, Drone Races and Bret's quests. 3) Only shares of the rest: 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies. 4) Complete any 100 optional missions of the 200 to 300 available. 5) Reach 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 15 of 18 meditations. 6) Budget around 100 hours for this phase. 7) Nothing on the checklist is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.summary: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts scattered over Leonida — stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count toward the same total.

steps.text: There are 397 stunts in total: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps — any 250 of them earn the trophy.
Under the Bridges are the quickest to rack up, so favour them when grinding the count.
Track progress at Progress > Activities > Stunts — press R3 on a category for the per-region breakdown.
The map's Exploration > Stunt Spots view shows where the remaining stunts are.
Keep going past 250 if you are chasing 100%: the checklist wants 300 stunts.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. Steps: 1) The 397 split into 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps — any 250 earn the trophy. 2) Under the Bridges are quickest, so favour them. 3) Track progress at Progress > Activities > Stunts, pressing R3 for the per-region breakdown. 4) Use the map's Exploration > Stunt Spots view for the rest. 5) The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.summary: Sample every one of the nine activity types once — most players earn this naturally while exploring Leonida.

steps.text: The nine activity types are Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball, Playing a Video Game, winning a Race (car race, Race Challenge or Top Fun Drone Race), and performing a Stunt.
Check which types you have already tried at Touchpad > Progress > Activities.
Filter the map for Activities — the blue dumbbell icons — to find the nearest example of each missing type.
For basketball, sinking one basket is enough to register the type.

trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once. Steps: 1) The nine are Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball, Playing a Video Game, winning a Race (car race, Race Challenge or Top Fun Drone Race) and performing a Stunt. 2) Check what you have tried at Touchpad > Progress > Activities. 3) Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icons) to find each missing type. 4) For basketball, one sunk basket registers the type.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.summary: Gold-medal every Shooting Range challenge — 42 golds in total. Guides disagree on how the ranges are laid out, so lean on the in-game tracker rather than any single map.

steps.text: You need a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds in total.
PowerPyx and GTABase describe the 42 challenges as spread across 12 range locations.

Push Square instead names two range locations — Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero — with most challenges in three difficulty tiers, all needing gold.
Some challenges are locked behind conditions, so revisit ranges as you progress through the game.
Ranges also raise your Focus level, which pays off later for Gunslinger.
Track what is left at Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges.

callouts.title: Sources disagree — how the ranges are laid out
callouts.text: PowerPyx [1] and GTABase [9] count 12 Shooting Range locations holding the 42 challenges; Push Square [8] and OutputLag [3] describe two ranges holding them between them. The 42-gold total itself agrees everywhere.

trophies.guide: Gold-medal every Shooting Range challenge — 42 golds in total. Steps: 1) Earn gold in all 42 challenges. 2) PowerPyx and GTABase spread them across 12 range locations. 3) Push Square instead names two ranges — Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range (Port Gellhorn) and Griffin Shooting Range (Balsero) — with most challenges in three difficulty tiers, all needing gold. 4) Some challenges unlock behind conditions, so revisit ranges as you progress. 5) Ranges also raise your Focus level for Gunslinger. 6) Track the rest at Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.summary: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — one win per spot is enough for the trophy.

steps.text: Win at least one Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations.
There are 42 drone races in total across those locations, and the 100% checklist wants all of them — finishing each location while you are there saves a return trip.
Some locations charge an entry fee, so bring cash.
Find and track locations at Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.

trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location. Steps: 1) Win at least one race at each of the 14 locations. 2) There are 42 races in total and the 100% checklist wants all of them, so finish each location while you are there. 3) Some locations charge an entry fee — bring cash. 4) Track locations at Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.summary: Win 20 different races — repeat wins on the same race do not count, so keep moving to new events.

steps.text: Win 20 different races; winning the same race twice does not count.
There are 40 unique race locations to choose from, so pick the ones that suit your driving.
Many locations let you hire a car for the race if your own is not competitive.
Track your wins at Touch Pad > Progress > Activities > Racing.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Steps: 1) Repeat wins on the same race do not count. 2) Choose from 40 unique race locations and pick ones that suit your driving. 3) Many locations let you hire a car if yours is not competitive. 4) Track wins at Touch Pad > Progress > Activities > Racing.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.summary: Beat Cal in his fishing challenge — on the live board this is the most-earned trophy after the tutorial, so it is very doable early.

steps.text: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal); afterwards he texts you and marks a fishing spot west of Key Lento with a purple icon.
Cal asks for a Parrotfish over 2 kg — fish the marked area until you land one.
You will need a boat with a fishing rod; hijack one nearby if you do not own one.
Play through his fishing quests and beat him in the challenge itself to pop the trophy.

trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Steps: 1) Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal); he then texts you and marks a fishing spot west of Key Lento with a purple icon. 2) He asks for a Parrotfish over 2 kg — fish the marked area until you land one. 3) You need a boat with a fishing rod; hijack one nearby if needed. 4) Play through his fishing quests and beat him in the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.summary: Finish one video game in full — three of the four are sitting on the TV at home from Chapter 1.

steps.text: Complete one video game in full: finishing all of its levels once is what counts.
Three games — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1.
The fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is found on arcade machines around Leonida.
Finishing any single one of the four earns the trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Steps: 1) Finish one video game in full — all of its levels, once. 2) Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1. 3) The fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade machines around Leonida. 4) Finishing any single one earns the trophy.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.summary: Finish Andy's five-quest line — it belongs to Lucia alone and starts with a phone call in Chapter 3.

steps.text: Andy's questline is Lucia-exclusive: in Chapter 3 he calls her, then texts the address of his Belville home, and the quests are auto-marked from there.
Work through all five of his quests in order — the last one, Puff Puff Pass, awards the trophy.
The line stays available after the story, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Steps: 1) His line is Lucia-exclusive — in Chapter 3 he calls her, then texts his Belville home address, and the quests auto-mark from there. 2) Work through all five quests in order; the last, Puff Puff Pass, awards the trophy. 3) The line stays available after the story, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.summary: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving line: seven shipwrecks, a patron who vanishes after Chapter 1 — and who does come back.

steps.text: Kenton hires you in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams (Work for Kenton) — look for the green KR icon in Key Lento.
His quests send you diving to 7 shipwrecks: dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig the treasure up.
He goes quiet after Chapter 1 but returns during Chapters 2–3 and texts Jason — calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds his return.
Track progress at Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
His final mission, Maritime Disputes, awards the trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Steps: 1) He hires you in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams (Work for Kenton) — green KR icon in Key Lento. 2) Dive his 7 shipwrecks at the purple chest markers and dig with the metal detector. 3) He vanishes after Chapter 1 but returns during Chapters 2–3 and texts Jason; calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds it up. 4) Track progress at Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures. 5) His final mission, Maritime Disputes, awards the trophy.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.summary: Finish Billy's five jobs out of the Thrillbilly Mudclub — they open after Coffee Break and wait for you after the story too.

steps.text: Billy's jobs open after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete all five of his jobs; the fifth, Hometown Heroes, awards the trophy.
Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it carries this trophy instead.
The jobs stay open after the story, so there is no rush and no way to miss them.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Steps: 1) His jobs open after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. 2) Complete all five; the fifth, Hometown Heroes, awards the trophy. 3) His strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it carries this trophy instead. 4) The jobs stay open after the story, so they cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.summary: Finish eight qualifying stranger strands — but only some strangers count, and the named quest-givers who have their own trophies are not among them.

steps.text: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
Confirmed to count: the strands for Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Confirmed not to count: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie — those quest lines carry their own trophies or none.
Do Yago's timed Chapter 3 race, Race Against Yago, the moment it appears — its hourglass icon means it can expire.
Check the trophy's own progress counter in your trophy list after each strand to confirm it registered.
Stranger strands are not part of the 100% checklist, and they stay available after the story.

trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Steps: 1) Finish eight qualifying strands. 2) Confirmed to count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete. 3) Confirmed not to count: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie. 4) Do Yago's timed Chapter 3 race, Race Against Yago, the moment it appears — the hourglass icon means it can expire. 5) Check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list after each strand. 6) Strands are not part of the 100% checklist and stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.summary: Work Randy's Wish List: 16 wanted sports cars, stolen to order with the Key Cloner and checked with the WAiNK app.

steps.text: Randy's Wish List auto-marks after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy), which also unlocks the Key Cloner.
Find him at the green RK icon west of Vice City.
The list names 16 wanted sports cars — scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is on the list before you steal it.
Deliver the cars and finish his final mission to earn the trophy.
Track the list at Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Steps: 1) His Wish List auto-marks after Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy), which also unlocks the Key Cloner. 2) Find him at the green RK icon west of Vice City. 3) The list names 16 wanted sports cars — scan cars with the WAiNK app to check the list before stealing. 4) Deliver the cars and finish his final mission. 5) Track the list at Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.summary: Finish Tyrone's short Jason-only line: wreck the Synthetic Labs, then spin on the finale.

steps.text: Tyrone's line is Jason-only and auto-marks after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty.
First destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in purple — the quest Take Out Kitty Litter.
His second quest, Spin On This, then unlocks and awards the trophy on completion.
Note that Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it carries this trophy instead.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Steps: 1) His line is Jason-only and auto-marks after Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty. 2) Destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in purple (Take Out Kitty Litter). 3) His second quest, Spin On This, then unlocks and awards the trophy. 4) His strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it carries this trophy instead.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.summary: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — and the one trophy on this list you can genuinely lock yourself out of, because one spot sits on the balcony of Jason's house, in Chapter 1 only.

steps.text: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, check the house in the morning: Lucia is in the kitchen and announces she is going to meditate on the balcony.
Follow her out, talk to her and choose Accept — that balcony meditation is only offered during Chapter 1, before the house becomes unavailable.
Keep a Chapter 1 manual save until you have done it — with no mission replay, that save is your only insurance.
There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations in total, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2.
A meditation only registers once the final zen animation has played — do not walk away early.
Track your count at Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations, or on the map at Touch Pad > Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida.
The final meditation needs both characters playable together, which opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.

trophies.missableNote: One meditation spot — the balcony at Jason's house — is only available in Chapter 1. The house is unavailable afterwards and there is no mission replay, so do it before Chapter 1 ends.

callouts.title: Possibly missable — act in Chapter 1
callouts.text: The balcony meditation at Jason's house exists only in Chapter 1 and there is no mission replay. Every guide that flags a missable flags this one [1] [6] [7] [11].

callouts.title: Sources disagree — does the trophy need the balcony spot?
callouts.text: OutputLag [3] says the balcony meditation counts toward the 18 and disappears after Chapter 1. PowerPyx [1] notes it raises the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot, and is unsure whether it is required — its author had done it when the trophy popped. Separately, the 100% checklist is satisfied at 15 of 18 spots [1] [4], so A Long Road is safe either way.

trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots, and the one possibly-missable trophy on the list. Steps: 1) In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, check the house in the morning: Lucia announces she is going to meditate on the balcony. 2) Follow her, talk to her and choose Accept — the balcony spot is only offered in Chapter 1. 3) Keep a Chapter 1 manual save until you have done it; there is no mission replay. 4) There are 18 spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both characters at a spot counts +2. 5) Let the final zen animation play or the meditation does not register. 6) Track the count at Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. 7) The final meditation needs both characters playable together, which opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Sources disagree on whether the trophy strictly needs the balcony spot: OutputLag says it counts, PowerPyx is unsure — do it anyway.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.summary: Hunt the unique animal Bret Vogel sends you after — his Target Deck questline is Jason-only and doubles as 100% progress.

steps.text: Bret Vogel's line is Jason-only: after Chapter 2's Coffee Break he texts you — the quest Veteran Hunted — in Lummox County.
He gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle; if you lose it, retrieve it from an Ammu-Nation weapon locker.
Work his Target Decks: there are 15 in total under Map > Activities > Target Deck, and all 15 are needed for 100%.
One clean shot keeps the carcass pristine — it pays more, though it is not mandatory.
Hunt the unique animal he asks for to earn the trophy; guides have not confirmed the exact animal yet.

trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Steps: 1) His line is Jason-only — after Chapter 2's Coffee Break he texts you (Veteran Hunted) in Lummox County. 2) He gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle; retrieve it from an Ammu-Nation weapon locker if lost. 3) Work his 15 Target Decks at Map > Activities > Target Deck — all 15 are needed for 100%. 4) One clean shot keeps the carcass pristine and pays more. 5) Hunt the unique animal he asks for; the exact animal is not yet confirmed by guides.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.summary: Complete any 3 full Collectible Card sets — a gentle start to a collection the 100% checklist later takes much further.

steps.text: Complete any 3 full Collectible Card sets.
There are 18 sets in the game, and the 100% checklist wants 15 of them — keep collecting past 3 if you are going for A Long Road.
Track your sets at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.
Collected cards can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count toward your sets.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Steps: 1) Finish any 3 full sets. 2) There are 18 sets in the game and the 100% checklist wants 15, so keep collecting if you are going for A Long Road. 3) Track sets at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards. 4) Collected cards can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.summary: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app — landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags all count, and there are more than 100 out there.

steps.text: WAiNK 100 locations with the WAiNK app: hold Up to open it, then hold R1 to scan.
Scannable categories include 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags — more than 100 objects exist, and any 100 count.
Track your progress at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.
The 100% checklist asks for the same 100 scans, so this trophy and A Long Road progress together.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Steps: 1) Open the WAiNK app by holding Up, then hold R1 to scan. 2) Categories include 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and No Flusher Tags — more than 100 objects exist and any 100 count. 3) Track progress at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations. 4) The 100% checklist asks for the same 100 scans.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.summary: Complete 50 of the game's 80 Challenges — they are all available from the start, in eight categories of ten.

steps.text: Complete 50 of the game's 80 Challenges.
Challenges sit in eight categories of 10, from Combat to Vehicle, and they are all available from the start.
Track them at Progress > Challenges — a Completed checkmark shows bottom-right on finished ones.
The 100% checklist raises the bar to 70 of 80, so keep going after this trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Steps: 1) Finish 50 of the 80 Challenges. 2) They sit in eight categories of 10, from Combat to Vehicle, all available from the start. 3) Track them at Progress > Challenges — finished ones carry a Completed checkmark. 4) The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so keep going after this pops.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.summary: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you and get fully out of the heat — the trophy only counts once you leave the red zone.

steps.text: Partner free-roam is required, and it opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle.
Reach a 4-star Wanted Level together, then lose it and leave the red heat zone completely; the trophy pops only after you exit the zone.
The most reliable escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County.
Bank vault robberies give 4 stars instantly, so escaping one with your partner during Chapter 4's That's Where The Money Is… also earns this.

trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Steps: 1) Partner free-roam opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. 2) Reach 4 stars together, lose them and leave the red heat zone completely; the trophy pops only after you exit. 3) The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the most reliable escape. 4) Vault robberies give 4 stars instantly, so escaping one with your partner also earns this.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.summary: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while the heat stays on — the chain breaks if your stars fade into the red zone.

steps.text: Call your partner first — this needs both of you, and partner play opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Rob 3 shops back-to-back while the wanted level stays in the flashing search phase; if the stars fade into the red heat zone, the chain breaks.
The three jewelry stores in north Vice City sit close together and are ideal — they open up after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
Rob a couple of items per store and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs to keep the chain fast.
The unlock can lag about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop — if it still does not pop, rob a fourth.

trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Steps: 1) Call your partner — partner play opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. 2) Rob 3 shops in a row while the wanted level stays in the flashing search phase; if the stars fade to the red heat zone, the chain breaks. 3) The three jewelry stores in north Vice City sit close together and are ideal, after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. 4) Take a couple of items per store and crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs. 5) The unlock can lag ~30 seconds after the third shop — rob a fourth if it does not pop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.summary: Discover 100 vehicles — scanning them with the WAiNK app counts, so you never have to drive them.

steps.text: Discover vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app: hold Up, look at the vehicle, hold R1.
Scanning is enough — getting inside a vehicle also registers it, but you do not need to drive it.
Stand at a busy road and scan everything that passes for fast progress.
Track your count at Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
There are 557 vehicles at launch and 277 base models; the 100% checklist wants 200 of the base models scanned.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Steps: 1) Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app — hold Up, look at the vehicle, hold R1. 2) Scanning is enough; getting in also registers, but driving is not needed. 3) Stand at a busy road and scan everything that passes. 4) Track the count at Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. 5) There are 557 vehicles at launch and 277 base models; the 100% checklist wants 200 base models scanned.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.summary: Drop five enemies inside a single Combat Focus — preparation matters more than aim: fill the meter, pick the right crowd, then fire.

steps.text: Combat Focus is triggered by pressing L3+R3 while aiming.
Fill and buff Focus first: food and drinks help, washing your face or showering at home raises it, and Adrenaline (hold L1, then Triangle) extends it.
Line up five enemies at a Gang Operation and use an assault rifle such as the Duke 556; wear body armour.
It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians — only gang-type enemies count.
Focus has four levels, raised through Shooting Range challenges, Golf, Pool, fishing and headshots.

trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Steps: 1) Trigger Combat Focus with L3+R3 while aiming. 2) Fill and buff Focus first — food and drinks help, washing your face or showering raises it, Adrenaline (L1, then Triangle) extends it. 3) Line up five enemies at a Gang Operation with an assault rifle like the Duke 556, wearing body armour. 4) Soldiers, police and civilians do not count — only gang-type enemies. 5) Focus has four levels, raised via Shooting Range challenges, Golf, Pool, fishing and headshots.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.summary: Steal a passenger jet from a boarding gate at VCIA and get airborne — the airport's open-apron planes do not count.

steps.text: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA — planes parked on the open airfield do not count.
The easiest targets sit at departure terminals E3 and E4; enter via the stairs door by the bridge or through the terminal.
Save first — the police respond fast.
Take off and fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) away; the trophy pops with a delay.

trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steps: 1) Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — airfield planes do not count. 2) The easiest targets are at departure terminals E3 and E4; enter via the stairs door by the bridge or through the terminal. 3) Save first — the police respond fast. 4) Take off and fly about 1 km away; the trophy pops with a delay.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.summary: Climb into a Rhino tank at the Mile Zero air station and put its gun to work — the vaguest description on the list hides a simple theft.

steps.text: Rhino tanks are parked at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the base.
Save before you go in; it is a military base and the response is heavy.
Get into a tank and shoot enemies from inside it until the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Steps: 1) Rhino tanks are parked at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the base. 2) Save before you go in; the military response is heavy. 3) Get into a tank and shoot enemies from inside it until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.summary: Rob a jewelry store cleanly: Snap Gun in through the back, safe code from the note, footage destroyed, alarm off, gone.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs first — it gives you the Snap Gun, which sits in your permanent inventory with no equipping needed.
Use the Snap Gun on the store's back door; kicking the door triggers the alarm and voids the attempt.
Inside, find the note with the safe code in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target.
The trophy pops shortly after you leave undetected; if you are spotted, reload and retry.

trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Steps: 1) Finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs for the Snap Gun — it sits in your permanent inventory, no equipping needed. 2) Use the Snap Gun on the back door; kicking it triggers the alarm and voids the attempt. 3) Find the note with the safe code in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. 4) Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. 5) The trophy pops shortly after you leave undetected; reload if spotted.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.summary: Rob five bank vaults and escape — the vaults open up through a late Chapter 4 optional mission, and every one of them brings instant 4-star heat.

steps.text: Unlock vaults through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe).
Tail a security van until a guard carries the cash briefcase in and the vault opens, then go in while it is open.
Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone; hold Right to hand a bag off.
There are 8 Large Bank Jobs in total: any 5 earn the trophy, all 8 are needed for 100%, and each can pay up to $205,000.
Vault robberies instantly give 4 stars, and the robbery only counts once you have escaped the red heat zone.
Afterwards Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 — do his earlier quests, including robbing 2 Payday Loans, to unlock them.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Steps: 1) Unlock vaults through Chapter 4's optional That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe). 2) Tail a security van until a guard carries the cash briefcase in and the vault opens, then go in while it is open. 3) Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone; hold Right to hand one off. 4) There are 8 Large Bank Jobs: any 5 earn the trophy, all 8 are needed for 100%, each paying up to $205,000. 5) Vaults give instant 4 stars and count only once you escape the red heat zone. 6) Yasmani later sells security-van tips for $10,000 after his earlier quests.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.summary: Rob an armored truck and get away — with a late-game shortcut: a bank vault job counts for this trophy too.

steps.text: The late-game method: rob a large bank vault once vaults are unlocked — a vault job counts for this trophy as well.
The earlier method: block a free-roam armored truck near a bank and blow its back door with sticky bombs, sold at Yasmani's shop after his jobs.
Escape the red heat radius afterwards — the trophy pops only once you are clear.

trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Steps: 1) Late-game shortcut — a large bank vault job counts for this trophy too, once vaults are unlocked. 2) Earlier method: block a free-roam armored truck near a bank and blow its back door with sticky bombs from Yasmani's shop. 3) Escape the red heat radius; the trophy pops only once you are clear.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.summary: Unfog the entire map of Leonida — a plane and a systematic sweep of the coastline and Keys get it done fastest.

steps.text: Fully unfog the map by exploring all of Leonida.
A plane is the fastest way to clear the fog — fly the coastline and the Keys systematically.
Work region by region so no pocket of the map stays fogged.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Steps: 1) Fully unfog the map. 2) A plane is the fastest way — fly the coastline and the Keys systematically. 3) Work region by region so no pocket stays fogged.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.summary: Hit one Illegal Operation for each of the nine gangs — the trophy wants breadth, while 100% wants all 39 operations.

steps.text: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.
There are 39 Illegal Gang Operations in total, marked with yellow icons: the trophy needs one per gang, but 100% wants all 39.
Track which gangs you have hit at Progress > Gangs.

trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Steps: 1) Hit one operation for each of the 9 gangs. 2) There are 39 operations in total, marked with yellow icons — one per gang for the trophy, all 39 for 100%. 3) Track gangs at Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.summary: A hidden one-liner: have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. One guide has a concrete method; some lists still mark the trigger unconfirmed.

steps.text: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing next to the bar.
Some lists still flag this trophy's exact trigger as unconfirmed, so if it does not pop, try again at a different time of day.

trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Steps: 1) Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach. 2) Buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing next to the bar. 3) Some lists still flag the exact trigger as unconfirmed — if it does not pop, try again at a different time of day.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.summary: Steal one specific blue Banshee from a south Vice City showroom and drive it out through the glass — only that car works.

steps.text: You need the Key Cloner, unlocked in Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs.
Steal the specific blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City — only that car works.
Drive it straight out through the showroom window; the trophy pops with a delay.

trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Steps: 1) You need the Key Cloner from Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. 2) Steal the specific blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City — only that car works. 3) Drive it out through the showroom window; the trophy pops with a delay.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.summary: Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn and take its three key valuables — and relax: it respawns, so it is not missable.

steps.text: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a Gang Operation, tied to the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.

Steal all three key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office — blow the safe with Sticky Bombs from Ammu-Nation.
The trophy pops after you escape the police.
Not missable: the robbery icon respawns, and the three valuables do not have to be taken in a single visit.

trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Steps: 1) Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a Gang Operation, tied to Chapter 2's optional Hit Kingpin Bowling. 2) Steal the three key valuables: the luxury watch (south-east office), the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 (north-east corner table) and the safe (north-east hallway office — blow it with Sticky Bombs). 3) The trophy pops after you escape the police. 4) Not missable: the icon respawns and the valuables need not be taken in one visit.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.summary: Get Jason and Lucia to maximum Strength at the same time — training together doubles the gains, so never work out alone.

steps.text: The trophy needs maximum Strength for BOTH characters at once; check it at Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (the heart icon).
It is possible from Chapter 2's Coffee Break onward, once you can free-roam together.
Buy a fitness-club membership and always train together: call your partner (hold Right + Triangle) and they train automatically alongside you, for double progress.
Filter Map > Activities for fitness clubs; you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal: maximum Strength for both characters at once. Steps: 1) Check Strength at Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon) — both Jason and Lucia must be maxed simultaneously. 2) Possible from Chapter 2's Coffee Break onward. 3) Buy a fitness-club membership and always train together — call your partner (hold Right + Triangle) and they train automatically alongside you for double progress. 4) Filter Map > Activities for fitness clubs, or work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.summary: Stack up 500 Criminal Profile actions — it comes naturally from robberies and encounters, and the game tracks it inside the trophy itself.

steps.text: Build 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — robberies and encounters all feed it passively as you play.
View your progress by clicking the trophy in your trophy list.
Turn on Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile to watch it move.
One caution: the Irredeemable criminal profile is permanent once reached — flavour rather than a trophy gate, but there is no undo.

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse): stack 500 Criminal Profile actions. Steps: 1) Robberies and encounters feed the profile passively as you play. 2) View progress by clicking the trophy in your trophy list. 3) Turn on Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile to watch it move. 4) Caution: the Irredeemable profile is permanent once reached — flavour, not a trophy gate, but there is no undo.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.summary: The one trophy nobody has fully cracked yet — guides list its method as unconfirmed, so this entry says so honestly and gives you the best current lead.

steps.text: No confirmed method exists yet: the unlock is listed as currently unknown, and several guides mark it unconfirmed.
The best current lead links it to the Prologue's Payday Loans store in Little Cuba — possibly robbing it again in a specific manner.
Guides are still confirming methods for a handful of hidden trophies, this one included — finish the rest of the list first and check back.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — the one trophy nobody has fully cracked yet. Steps: 1) No confirmed method exists; the unlock is listed as currently unknown and several guides mark it unconfirmed. 2) The best current lead links it to the Prologue's Payday Loans store in Little Cuba, possibly robbing it again in a specific manner. 3) Finish the rest of the list first and check back as methods get confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.summary: A UFO Easter egg on a road north-west of the Starlet Motel — go alone, at night, and be patient with a random spawn.

steps.text: Head to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night, after 2AM, and come solo.
A blinking car sometimes waits at the roadside — the spawn is random, so drive away and return if it is not there.
Follow the path into the woods and approach the UFO; it drops an abducted woman.
Talk to her and help her back to her car to earn the trophy.
Some lists still mark this method as unconfirmed — the route above is the most detailed account available.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A UFO Easter egg. Steps: 1) Head to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night, after 2AM, solo. 2) A blinking car sometimes waits roadside — the spawn is random, so drive away and return if it is absent. 3) Follow the path into the woods and approach the UFO; it drops an abducted woman. 4) Talk to her and help her back to her car. 5) Some lists mark the method unconfirmed; this is the most detailed account available.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.summary: Ten pedestrians, one bike, sixty seconds: ride through a crowd and kick as you go.

steps.text: Ride any bike and kick pedestrians with Square — you need 10 within 60 seconds.
Crowded areas such as Vice City and Ocean Beach give you the density you need.
Some lists still show this method as unconfirmed; the bike-and-kick route above is the working account.

trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Steps: 1) Ride any bike through a crowd and kick pedestrians with Square — 10 within 60 seconds. 2) Crowded areas like Vice City and Ocean Beach give you the density. 3) Some lists show the method as unconfirmed; the bike-and-kick route is the working account.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.summary: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills through your fences — Yasmani pays the best rate, so route the big hauls to him.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 3's Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob Banks and Payday Loans to pick up Marked Bills, then deliver them to a Fence to launder.
Yasmani in Vice City pays the most for marked bills.
The $250,000 is cumulative across all your robberies — it does not need to be a single haul.

trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Steps: 1) Finish Chapter 3's Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. 2) Rob Banks and Payday Loans for Marked Bills, then deliver them to a Fence. 3) Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. 4) The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies, not one haul.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.summary: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across every kind of shop — guns, car mods and tattoos burn through it fastest.

steps.text: Spend $100,000 in total across all shop types — it is a running total, not a single purchase.
Guns, car mods and tattoos burn money fastest: there are 24 Ammu-Nations, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 14 Mod Shops, 67 Clothing Stores and 11 Tattoo Studios.
It is cumulative across every kind of shop, so ordinary endgame spending on guns and car mods gets you there.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Steps: 1) It is a running total across all shop types, not a single purchase. 2) Guns, car mods and tattoos burn fastest — 24 Ammu-Nations, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 14 Mod Shops, 67 Clothing Stores, 11 Tattoo Studios. 3) Ordinary endgame spending counts, so it usually pops during the cleanup.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.summary: Buy the 8 garages sold through the Vice City Real Estate app — about $160,000 all-in, and the 4 story garages do not count.

steps.text: Buy garages through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, which opens after Chapter 2's Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses).
There are 8 purchasable garages, at about $160,000 in total.
The 4 garages the story gives you do not count — only the 8 bought ones do.
Buy them before grinding On the Spot: every garage adds parking spots you will need for registrations.

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Steps: 1) Buy through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, opened after Chapter 2's Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses). 2) There are 8 purchasable garages, about $160,000 in total. 3) The 4 story garages do not count. 4) Buy them before On the Spot — every garage adds parking spots for registrations.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.summary: Register 10 stolen vehicles to the Scooter Bros app through Moses — buy garage space first and register cheap cars to keep it affordable.

steps.text: The Scooter Bros app is installed after Chapter 2's Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses).
Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register.
Each registration needs a free garage space — buy garages first, and register cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep costs down.
At first only tracker-free vehicles can be registered; from Chapter 3, Standard Tracker cars can also be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray.
Register 10 vehicles to earn the trophy.

trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Steps: 1) The app is installed after Chapter 2's Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). 2) Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. 3) Each registration needs a free garage space — buy garages first and register cheap cars and bikes. 4) At first only tracker-free vehicles work; from Chapter 3, Standard Tracker cars can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. 5) Register 10 to earn the trophy.
